name: MAC flap (syslog) + interface metric anomaly (SNMP) on an oscillating port: MAC flap confirmed
comment: C5: mac_flap is emitted by the new MAC-flap syslog branch (%SW_MATM/%L2FM/%MACFLAP). The oscillating port's counter anomaly (device_telemetry) is the independent confirming witness. No coincident stp_topology_change, so the STP discriminator does not fire (the MAC flap is the root, not a symptom).
